name: dev
description: Provides development workflows, PR-writing guidance, code-craft preferences, runtime verification, and the stable bare `dev` lifecycle for Grove-backed projects.

requires.grove: Install Grove, then run `grove setup` in the source repository.

plan/reviewers/requirements-coverage.whenToUse: every requirement and design constraint maps to a concrete plan task, classified Covered/Partial/Missing; flags only blocking gaps

plan/reviewers/pattern-consistency.whenToUse: the plan honors the codebase's real conventions; reads actual source and cites the pattern each finding deviates from; owns contract-level conflicts between parts

plan/reviewers/code-smells.whenToUse: nullability mismatches, type conflicts across parts, hidden N+1s, over-fetching, missing error boundaries, leaky abstractions; owns file-level conflicts between parts

plan/reviewers/security.whenToUse: input validation, injection surfaces, auth/authz gaps, data exposure, races; reports only validated concrete exploit paths and asks the user about material unknown threat-model assumptions

plan/reviewers/architecture-fit.whenToUse: proposed files/modules/abstractions fit the system's existing decomposition; flags new units that duplicate existing ones or cross layer boundaries

spec/requirements.whenToUse: Derive testable EARS requirements from a finished, approved design — in isolation, from the rendered design text alone.
